title: ChannelSecurityProfile
description: Declared channel protection, without any secret value.

x-agp.mechanics: Defines the bounded channel-security-profile value crossing the neutral transport boundary.
x-agp.rationale: One schema and generated type prevent adapter-specific reinterpretation.
x-agp.consequence: A divergent shape makes transport implementations observably incompatible.

keying.description: Whether one secret covers the topology or one covers each identity.
